claim: R13 correctly identified partial V550J cache signature but stopped short of inspecting whether validation verdict blocks returned cache
contrary: _validate_prepared_substrate writes validation_status to report and returns; loaded-cache caller discards result, then returns cached prepared+manifest. Comparator only checks six fields, skips empty expected keys; source_id/run_id/canonical_wave/frame hash not compared on cache-hit.
boundary: Static possible stale or invalid cached frame; upstream caller may constrain values; no production wrong-data or execution claim.
fix: Mark V550J M stage as CONDITIONAL_REUSE__VALIDATION_REPORT_NOT_ENFORCED_AT_THIS_RETURN. Separate cache-key identity, config comparator, prepared-row validation and actual consumer; cheapest source-selected same-key changed-frame/manifest plus pass/fail gate owner.

claim: R13 correctly found certification function but its seven-stage causal chain presents certification as handoff without strict/late-veto regime
contrary: Compiler first certifies candidates, then can mark provenance/registry/scope issues and zero certified frames; separately if --strict is false it explicitly sets audit certified=False, zeros certified output and downstream-ready flags. Only post-final boundary status determines publishable allowed state.
boundary: Conditional source compile path only; it does not show certified packets in any selected original run.
fix: Stage 4 = preliminary per-packet gate; stage 5 = post-gate final strict/provenance publishing decision; stage 6 = manifest with physical/certified count and permission. Do not say candidate→certified→V552J is unconditional.

claim: R13 says forbidden inference and no-downstream-leakage gates are applied without distinguishing which are operative
contrary: The certification gate map assigns forbidden_inference_gate=True for each row; that particular gate cannot reject an individual row. A distinct permission_boundary_gate does test ready_for_v553, pressure_anchor_eligible, temporal_pressure_authorized and runtime_use_class, so this does not prove all leakage defenses absent.
boundary: Only the stated certification gate is tautological; no observed leakage or issuer grant.
fix: Record forbidden_inference_gate=CONSTANT_TRUE_NON_DISCRIMINATING; record permission_boundary_gate as actual static negative. Do not count two independent forbidden controls.

claim: R13 calls the manifest signed and treats certification/published hashes as authority without independently locating a signature verifier
contrary: Inspected compiler writes JSON manifest with per-artifact hashes/provenance and status; no cryptographic issuer signature or independent selected human/source authority appears in these cited lines. Hash integrity is not consent or authority issuance.
boundary: Does not refute valid SHA256 artifact checks, no assertion unsigned files are invalid under inherited law.
fix: Rename signed manifest to hash-declared producer manifest; require actual manifest SHA+certified-count+allow receipt and distinguish source integrity from issuer/science permission.

claim: R13 correctly notes V552J _coherent_scope does not compare source_id but must preserve real downstream permission vetoes
contrary: _coherent_scope checks run, source family, wave, country/shard and hashes; separate source_id not compared here. But build_v552j_join permits ALLOW only for a certified packet, both producer downstream_permission_status=ALLOW, matched fact permission ALLOW and observed score; cannot claim simple scope collision automatically authorizes output.
boundary: No observed same-family/different-source_id candidate or current authorized join; cannot infer cross-source contamination.
fix: Hold strict source_id equivalence at original sample/manifest check, preserve positive two-producer AND permission gating and review-only/denied outputs, no blanket loss.

claim: R13 assigns HIGH integration defect to three R12 local evidence IDs absent from unchanged R11 canonical proposed table
positive: R13's three local evidence registrations use inherited 10-column schema and R12 references local IDs under isolated scope.
contrary: R12 was expressly standalone staging, not an admitted R11 normalized replacement. Not having registered local IDs in unchanged upstream R11 DATA is a planned custody distinction, not broken R12-local FK proof.
boundary: Cannot promote those IDs or invent authority/decision events, but no S1 material loss follows from non-admission.
fix: Grade three IDs as PROPOSED_REGISTRATION_ONLY, add two new source objects for certification and publisher; integrator can register once after source grade, instead of treating staging itself as defective.

claim: R13 3x5 court repeats identical positive, ceiling and owner across all five R1 dimensions in each court
positive: R13 correctly does not pretend formal receiving or native runs.
contrary: Repeated cells are not independent demonstrations of future utility, navigability, comprehensibility and comprehensiveness; 24 verified blobs do not prove mapped same-semantic estate coverage.
boundary: A documentary formatting/review-reasoning limitation, not evidence of physical source loss.
fix: Replaced with 15 separately formulated questions, positives, falsifiers, and proof ceilings; no 3x5 acceptance claim.
